newsitem.title: USA: Nutrition Medical IPO declared effective.
newsitem.headline: Nutrition Medical IPO declared effective.

text.p: Nutrition Medical Inc said on Thursday that its initial public offering of 1.3 million shares of common stock at $3.50 per share has been declared effective by the Securities and Exchange Commission.

All of the shares are being sold by the company, which markets a variety of clinical nutrition products for hospitals and nursing homes, as well as a line of private-label adult nutrition supplements, which are sold nationally through retail chains. Net proceeds from the offering will be used to fund the development and marketing of new products and for other general working capital purposes, the company said.
